description.text: The eleventh Sun & Moon set, released on 2 August 2019 with 258 cards: 236 and 22 secret rares. Its eight new TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX include Mewtwo & Mew-GX, Espeon & Deoxys-GX, Umbreon & Darkrai-GX, Garchomp & Giratina-GX and Rowlet & Alolan Exeggutor-GX, beside nine more Pokémon-GX and two new Special Energy.
